rules.requirement: The package must declare the name and address of the manufacturer, packer or importer, as applicable.
rules.scope: Pre-packaged commodities meant for retail sale
rules.applicability: Applicable to retail packages; exact role depends on whether the commodity is manufactured, packed or imported.
rules.evidence_required: Visible manufacturer, packer or importer name and address declaration.
rules.source_document: Declaration of mandatory information on the outer retail package

rules.requirement: The package must declare the common or generic name of the commodity contained in the package.
rules.scope: Pre-packaged commodities meant for retail sale
rules.evidence_required: Visible common or generic name of the commodity.
rules.source_document: Declaration of mandatory information on the outer retail package

rules.requirement: The package must declare the net quantity in terms of a standard unit of weight or measure or in number, as applicable.
rules.scope: Pre-packaged commodities meant for retail sale
rules.evidence_required: Visible net quantity declaration with its unit or count.
rules.source_document: Declaration of mandatory information on the outer retail package

rules.requirement: The package must declare the month and year of manufacture, packing or import, as applicable.
rules.scope: Pre-packaged commodities meant for retail sale
rules.applicability: Applicable according to the nature of the package and applicable declaration.
rules.evidence_required: Visible month and year declaration relating to manufacture, packing or import.
rules.source_document: Declaration of mandatory information on the outer retail package

rules.requirement: The package must declare the retail sale price in the form of Maximum Retail Price (MRP) inclusive of all taxes.
rules.scope: Pre-packaged commodities meant for retail sale
rules.evidence_required: Visible MRP declaration with price in Indian currency and inclusive-of-all-taxes indication.
rules.source_document: Declaration of mandatory information on the outer retail package

rules.requirement: The retail sale price declaration must identify the Maximum Retail Price (MRP) and indicate that it is inclusive of all taxes.
rules.scope: Pre-packaged commodities meant for retail sale
rules.evidence_required: OCR evidence showing MRP and the required inclusive-of-all-taxes declaration.
rules.source_document: Declaration of mandatory information on the outer retail package

rules.requirement: The package must declare consumer care details.
rules.scope: Pre-packaged commodities meant for retail sale
rules.evidence_required: Visible consumer care contact details such as telephone, email or other declared consumer-care information.
rules.source_document: Declaration of mandatory information on the outer retail package

rules.requirement: The unit sale price must be declared for applicable pre-packaged commodities in the prescribed unit format.
rules.scope: Pre-packaged commodities meant for retail sale
rules.applicability: Applicable to pre-packaged commodities subject to the unit sale price requirement. Certain exceptions apply, including packages where retail sale price equals unit sale price.
rules.evidence_required: Visible unit sale price declaration using the applicable unit such as per g, per kg, per cm, per metre, per number, per ml or per litre.
